title: 3 Zipline Adventure and 3.5 hour Afternoon Snorkel Cruise
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Weight 60–275 lbs required for the zipline activity
Securable, close-toed athletic shoes required for the zipline
All ages welcome, with adult supervision for minors
Footwear must be removed when boarding the cruise vessel
Pregnant guests are advised to opt for an alternative activity
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Combine adrenaline and relaxation on this full-day Oʻahu adventure featuring a 3-zipline experience at Coral Crater Adventure Park and a 3.5-hour snorkeling cruise from Ko Olina.

Start at Coral Crater, where you’ll soar across three ziplines designed for both beginners and thrill-seekers. Enjoy a guided, safety-focused experience as you glide above the treetops and take in the surrounding jungle views.

Continue to Ko Olina Marina and step aboard a spacious cruise vessel for an afternoon on the water. Keep watch for dolphins, sea turtles, and seasonal humpback whales. After your swim, relax on board and enjoy a hot Hawaiian buffet featuring traditional island flavors and local-style dishes.

With optional transportation from Waikīkī, this combo offers a balanced mix of jungle adventure and ocean relaxation in one full-day Oʻahu experience, ideal for travelers looking to make the most of their time.
